subject: Intro & SOC 2 packet — next steps and timeline

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Intro & SOC 2 packet — next steps and timeline

Hi Anna —

Great to meet you on the call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we have shared alignment: 

- What we covered: Redwood provides hosted inference plus VPC-private deployment; we discussed latency SLOs, data residency, and your audit cadence.
- Deliverable shared: attached a compiled security packet (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram, auth controls, and a short runbook). See attachment: Redwood_Security_Packet_v1.zip.
- Suggested next steps: 1) Your security team reviews packet; 2) We schedule a 30-min technical follow-up to walk through any open controls; 3) If everything looks good, we can prepare a mutual action plan and draft PO/terms.

Are you able to share an internal target date for review? If it helps, I can set up a short walkthrough next week to go over any items the security or infra team flags.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0189

Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:06:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & SOC 2 packet — next steps and timeline

Thanks Rafael —

Appreciate the packet and the clear summary. Quick notes from our side:

- Received the ZIP and skimmed the SOC 2 attestation excerpt. Team will run a deeper review focused on encryption-in-transit, key management, and data retention policy.
- Timeline: security/infra team is juggling a quarterly audit; we expect an initial read in ~7–10 business days. Could be earlier if nothing pops up.
- Clarification: can you confirm whether customer-managed KMS for Private deployments requires any additional onboarding work or configuration effort on your side?

If you can share a short diagram or call availability for next Tue/Wed that would be helpful — we'll try to have a couple of engineers on the call.

Regards,
Anna Park
Head of IT Risk | NimbusWorks
anna@nimbusworks.com | +1 (206) 555-8741

Hi Anna —

Just following up to check on priority and timing for the SOC 2 packet review. Wanted to offer two quick options:

1) If your team is still on the 7–10 business day cadence you mentioned, I can tentatively book a 30-min walkthrough for Dec 8th to walk through the KMS and network diagrams.
2) If this is lower priority for now, would you be open to a short sync the week after to avoid interrupting your audit sprint?

To answer your KMS question from last time: for our Private deployment we support customer-managed KMS. There is a brief onboarding checklist (key rotation schedule and access controls) that our infra team assists with. Happy to share that checklist in advance of a walkthrough — attaching the two-page KMS checklist for context.

Proposed times for a 30-min slot (PT): Dec 8 10:00–10:30, Dec 8 14:00–14:30, Dec 9 11:00–11:30. Let me know which works best or suggest another time and I’ll send an invite.

Thanks — Rafael
